stopping_rule: Stop when further variations of the patch-dictionary size/stride, augmentation set and logistic-regression C give no 5-fold CV gain on data/train; then refit the best configuration on all training data once.

hyperparams.features: HOG(cell8) + HSV 4x4 hist + RGB 4x4 hist + LBP 4x4 hist + Coates-Ng k-means patch features (patch 6x6, whitened, triangle coding, 3x3 pooling)
